kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أنغسل (form VII)
# أَنْغَسِلُ (ʔanḡasilu) /ʔan.ɣa.si.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# أَنْغَسِلَ (ʔanḡasila) /ʔan.ɣa.si.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
# أَنْغَسِلْ (ʔanḡasil) /ʔan.ɣa.sil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْغَسَلَ (inḡasala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
